root_cause.mechanism: libttmplayer's GLES3/3.1 + EGL-ANDROID proc-address cache slots are declared OBJECT GLOBAL DEFAULT in .bss (105 of them: gl*/egl*). The proc-loader FUN_001ddcf0 does `p = eglGetProcAddress(name); *slot = p`, where &slot comes from a GOT entry bound by R_AARCH64_GLOB_DAT on that symbol name. OH musl do_relocs (oh61-dynlink-linux.c e50b30f2 L1389) self-binds ONLY when st_info>>4 == STB_LOCAL; for a GLOBAL symbol it calls find_sym_by_saved_so_list, which returns the OH provider's exported FUNC (libEGL/mali) of the same name. So GOT[0x473e58] (eglPresentationTimeANDROID) points at libEGL code (0x7d1d95e1f8), and the proc-loader's `str x0,[x9]` writes a pointer into a read-only code page -> SEGV_ACCERR.
root_cause.faulting_instruction: 0x1de6f0 adrp x0,0x4b9000 / 0x1de6f4 add x0,#0x3d (x0="eglPresentationTimeANDROID", file 0x3b903d); 0x1de6f8 bl eglGetProcAddress; 0x1de70c ldr x9,[x9,#0xe58] (x9=*GOT[0x473e58]); 0x1de714 str x0,[x9] = FAULT
root_cause.correction_note: an earlier readback named glActiveShaderProgram; that string was the crash-time x1 residual (a mali name-table pointer), not the call argument. The resolved name is eglPresentationTimeANDROID (byte-verified at file 0x3b903d). OBJECT<-FUNC preemption direction unchanged.
root_cause.classification: deterministic symbol preemption (OBJECT data slot preempted by provider FUNC) / API-assembly. NOT a random crash, NOT a surface/window problem, NOT anti-virtualization.
root_cause.r3_relation: r3 progressed execution to the proc-loader instruction (reached eglGetProcAddress + the storing str); this is NOT a complete-load verdict — the player's own GOT/loading was never fully verified. Masked before r3 because the libvcbasekit ns0 relocation died first.

fix.summary: single derived libttmplayer.so: rewrite the 105 family GLOB_DAT relocations in .rela.dyn to R_AARCH64_RELATIVE with addend = each symbol's own .bss st_value. OH musl L1452 does *slot = base + addend, so each GOT slot self-binds to libttmplayer's own writable .bss cache; the proc-loader's store then lands in .bss.

derived.transform: 105 GLOB_DAT(sym,addend=0) -> RELATIVE(sym=0,addend=st_value); 627 bytes differ, all within those 105 relocations' r_info/r_addend (1680-byte written span). Symbol table, .gnu.hash/.hash, code, section permissions byte-identical.
derived.scope_filter: GLOB_DAT whose symbol is OBJECT GLOBAL, st_shndx == .bss (23), name gl*/egl*. Count == 105 (gate). Excludes the 4 C++ vtables _ZTVN6vcloud8ttplayer*ConfigE / TTFlexPlayer (OBJECT GLOBAL GLOB_DAT in .data.rel.ro shndx 19) -> left as GLOB_DAT.

rejected_alternatives.STV_HIDDEN: musl do_relocs does not check visibility (L1389 only STB_LOCAL) -> hidden GLOBAL still preempted. Ineffective.
rejected_alternatives.STB_LOCAL: would self-bind (L1389) but ELF requires locals before globals; moving 105 scattered globals needs .dynsym reorder + sh_info + .gnu.hash/.hash rebuild. Large blast radius; also de-exports them. Rejected as non-minimal.
rejected_alternatives.DF_SYMBOLIC/RTLD_DEEPBIND: musl do_relocs does not honor either at L1389. Ineffective.
rejected_alternatives.loader_local_first: a link_stubs/musl change affecting ALL targets; broader, needs P0/feed re-verification. Deferred.
rejected_alternatives.surface_window_wrapping: not the cause (fault is symbol preemption, not a window/ANW call). Not pursued this round.
rejected_alternatives.mprotect_or_rw_code: rejected by directive — would mask the wrong binding, not fix it.

blast_radius.chosen_B_selfrel: 1 file, 105 .rela.dyn entries (r_info+r_addend). Symbol table/hash/code/perms unchanged. Rewrites the 105-symbol potential same-family cache set in one pass (data caches, 0 PLT uses); this run OBSERVED exactly 1 fault (eglPresentationTimeANDROID at GOT 0x473e58) — the other 104 are foreseeable same-class collisions, not observed.
blast_radius.A_stb_local: 1 file but multi-section surgery (dynsym order + sh_info + 2 hash tables); high regression risk.
blast_radius.C_loader: cross-cutting loader behavior change; affects every target.
